patch_list: Removes duplicate permission declarations that block installing the patched app on Samsung phones (INSTALL_FAILED_DUPLICATE_PERMISSION). Enable this only if the install fails on a Samsung device; it is unnecessary on non-Samsung phones.
LocalThings Owner PSK in device settings
Shows a device's OwnerPSK (for Home Assistant LocalThings) on its Edit screen, extracted locally via the app's own key store. Tested on HW-Q950A / SmartThings 1.8.54.23, 1.8.52.23.
Use web login on Samsung phones
